value: Whether short-term priming can be measured behaviourally in freely-moving mice using an auditory task.
Can an auditory discrimination task reveal short-term priming in mice, and does it fit a formal definition of priming?

Demonstrates short-term auditory priming in freely-moving mice and briefly presents the meta-disciplinary priming definition (association, secondariness, modulation) used to guide this project's tagging.

quote: We conducted a total of 52 priming sessions in four mice, with a median [IQR] of 148 [91 199] trials per session, of which 71 [34 91] were PTs.
The results establish the short-term priming phenomenon in rodents, and the paradigm opens the door to studying the cellular-network basis of priming.
